break-loop-choice-preview.route: On BREAK PART LOOP A/B, a physical eligible encoder detent auditions a candidate. SELECT confirms within the choice window; HOME cancels, or expiry/guard change stops it. LIST ALGO / unassigned SMK arrow can audition an unbound loop row while the LIST still owns the body; not a second preview screen. SMC normally pattern-binds R_BRKSLOT, so its knob does not qualify for the unbound preview. Controller edit can cancel the preview without entering it. envelope-touch-readout.route: Active envelope encoder movement on a bound normal page temporarily owns the response/caption until release/timeout. Suppressed under HELP/LIST/ASK and SMC grid. project-transfer-header.route: Project load/save/import ownership changes through accepted project action; ui_frame early returns after draw_header while project_busy, cancels SMC and discards edits. Returns to initialized or originating screen per project action rather than another menu route.

playhead-render-ownership.route: Accepted local PLAY, scheduled song/pattern start, and accepted host transport affect live playhead independently from selected step/LED. HOME.exactPhysical: ac63b270-song-live-mute-receipt.json contains actual SONG→HOME, with playback continuing; no claim of all part seeds.

SONG.entry: From clear HOME tap HOME, then use SELECT encoder detents to select BAR page 0/1 (bounded, not wrapping). On stock SMK, ordinary < or > produces the same SELECT encoder detent; no menu/CLIP/HOME/held-effect interposition.
SONG.exits: HOME returns HOME; SEL opens SONG LIST. LIST parameter selection does not enter another BAR page: list_enter only dispatches sections/actions. Back retains shared BAR selection; GLO return retains SONG.
SONG.exactPhysical: ac63b270-song-live-mute-receipt.json and ac63b270-confirm-action-journeys-receipt.json prove HOME→SONG and actual SONG list ingress once. Both BAR banks are source-qualified; no dedicated native BAR page-1 rerun claimed.

PERF.entry: GLO → SYSTEM section (R_SECTION index 5) → PERFORMANCE (R_ACT/ACT_PERF) → physical SEL enters V_PERF. set_view clears the list overlay. SELECT detents have only page 0.
PERF.exits: Idle HOME returns HOME. SEL → PERF LIST → START closes list and starts test on same PERF view. Active HOME or PLAY aborts without navigation; deferred audio/foreground tick restores idle. Other mode-key exits apply only when PERF is not consuming input.
PERF.exactPhysical: ac63b270-system-perf-ingress-receipt.json SYSTEM_PERF_INGRESS PASS (10 checks), actual panel workflow and abort restoration; no print claiming every alias ran.

primaryAlternates.notEquivalent: SMC HOME note 6 or strip-8 REC note 7 toggles independent smc.view HOME/SONG only (smc_mixer.c:1651-1662,2142-2150,2191). Do not treat note alone as persistent local ui.view ingress.
primaryAlternates.actual: If SMC view is HOME/SONG, PAUSE captures lock_view/page/part. A short PAUSE release or locked PAGE ± may temporarily reveal the captured real local screen (smc_mixer.c:738-748,768-776,1451-1519,2247-2254). On timeout the saved local page/part/cursor returns; navigation can supersede it. Route requires O_NONE and no HELP/CLIP/perf test/project busy.
primaryAlternates.evidence: ac63b270-smc-peek-ownership-receipt.json proves shared PAUSE/timeout mechanism. HOME/SONG specific targets source-qualified, not independently replayed in this slice.
primaryAlternates.perf: No stock SMC navigation producer found for smc.view=V_PERF; no unsupported direct SMC PERF ingress claimed. Generic peek restoration can return a previously saved PERF screen, not select PERF.

engineEditorIngress.physical: Select Bass A/B with ALGORITHM. EDIT/PARA opens PART; repeat or K2 selector cycles descriptor pages for the committed engine. SEQ opens that engine’s three sequencer pages; repeat cycles them.
engineEditorIngress.bankChange: PART SOUND ENGINE knob or contextual LIST edit uses R_BENGINE → pref_set_from → engine_bass_select_preset, then cursor/layout reflown. R_BPRESET changes the preset in the requested bank; publication gate can retain previous screen or show pending.
engineEditorIngress.remoteBankChange: When an authorized peer dispatch exposes that descriptor, the same ref requests bank/preset, but the selected SOUND page is retained until a physical input accepts the new layout. A mapped pinned SMC preset is distinct from all SMC strips changing banks.
engineEditorIngress.patternRecall: A queued or active pattern with a stored bass preset can change the committed bank after pattern and silence gating; withdrawing the cue cancels a gate for an inactive pattern. Visible editor refreshes when observed bank changes.
engineEditorIngress.scope: Bank routes prove screen ingress/ownership with published test and source, not every preset or endpoint. #987 desktop selector changes remain separately identified in merged catalog and reviewed exact deltas.
